methodology.scenario: Single cast, unlimited-health stationary dummies 70px away; group includes 5 near and behind; moving uses moveX -0.35 after cast; input is normalized to full movement speed. Damage per cooldown is a theoretical ratio, not actual rotation DPS.
methodology.warning: TargetsHit counts only damage, not control. Intentional healing/shields/mobility can have zero damage; temporary utility and counterplay require separate tests. Dummy boss/elite are flags, not real boss AI. No human playtest.
